fields.title: PHASE 3 — The Picture 10 Years Out: 3 Scenarios (2036, $1 billion units) — Recalculated
fields.md:
**Baseline**: Because the latest quarter is still 3Q26, the starting point is the same as in the October issue: **3Q26 annualized revenue of $58.3 billion** (formula: 14,575 × 4 — AI $30.2 billion · Connectivity $21.0 billion · Space $7.1 billion). The scenario figures were rebuilt from the same baseline, and **no cell changed by more than 20% versus the previous round** (source: [8-K Ex.99.1](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1181412/000162828026066482/spaceexplorationtechnologi.htm) · October issue PHASE 3).

| Item | Bull (P=25%) | Base (P=50%) | Bear (P=25%) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Connectivity revenue | 190 | 140 | 75 |
| Space revenue | 35 | 25 | 15 |
| AI revenue | 480 | 160 | 40 |
| **Total revenue** | **705** | **325** | **130** |
| Operating income | 229 | 91 | 13 |
| Net income | 167 | 60 | ~0 |
| FCF | 130 | 45 | (5) |
| Net debt | 250 | 180 | 200 |

(Source: estimates built from the PHASE 1 actuals in this report — same as October issue PHASE 3. Probabilities in Section 0-3)

**One-line rationale (changes only)**: Bull — no change ($15 billion per GW held for 2 quarters + 13GW at end of 2027 + Ship recovery). Base — no change (ARPU reverting to the $50s, AI stalling at 8GW). Bear — adds to the rationale **"the top 2 customers both hold termination options in 2027-1H (reported)"**. The numbers stay the same — no adjustments outside the rules. The "financing rate in the 8% range reported" used in the October issue remains an **assumption not yet confirmed**, since the lease rate is still undetermined (source: 1-4·1-5 · [Yahoo/Bloomberg 10/29](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/anthropic-accounts-over-third-spacex-014451805.html)).

**Probability adjustment rules (pre-committed, unchanged)** (source: `state.probability_adjustment_rules`)

| Condition | Adjustment | Status |
|---|---|---|
| Annual revenue per GW above $10 billion in 3Q26/4Q26 | Bull +5, Bear −5 | Triggered (2026-10, exhausted) |
| Successful Ship recovery by 2027-06 | Bull +5, Bear −5 | Pending — Flight 15 is the first attempt |
| Equity raise within 2027 (including convertible bonds) | Bear +10, Bull −5 | Pending |
| ARPU below $60 for 2 consecutive quarters | Bear +5, Base −5 | Pending (currently $69) |
| Kuiper has not launched a US consumer plan by end of 2027 | Base +5, Bear −5 | Pending (11/1 check: not launched, LV-01 11/13) |
| Top 2 AI customers confirm 2029 renewal | Bull +10, Bear −10 | Pending |
| 3 consecutive misses on the same axis | Full recalculation | Not applicable (Axis E: 1) |

---

[The investment-judgment paragraph has been omitted from the public view — this page is an observation record, not a recommendation.]
